links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompt without example prompts, across Llama 3.2 3B and Llama 3.1 8B at temperatures 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75
links.outcome: Accuracy of stigmatizing language detection in clinical notes
links.effect: Examples improved accuracy across all configurations. Best configuration was 8B, temperature 0.25, with examples: accuracy 70.2%, TPR 94.1%, TNR 47.4%. The 3B model without examples had TNR 99.7% but TPR 2%.
links.tradeoff: The best configuration with examples had a low TNR (47.4%), so it flags many non-stigmatizing notes. The 3B model without examples almost never detected stigmatizing language (TPR 2%).
links.quote: The inclusion of examples improved model accuracy across all configurations, while temperature settings had a variable impact, with smaller models benefiting from higher temperatures and larger models performing better at lower temperatures.

links.comparator_used: Higher temperature settings (0.5, 0.75) versus lower (0.25), compared within each model size
links.outcome: Accuracy, TPR and TNR of stigmatizing language detection
links.effect: Impact varied by model size: the larger 8B model performed better at lower temperature (best overall accuracy 70.2% at 0.25 with examples), while smaller models benefited from higher temperatures.
links.quote: The inclusion of examples improved model accuracy across all configurations, while temperature settings had a variable impact, with smaller models benefiting from higher temperatures and larger models performing better at lower temperatures.
